note: SySTeC is described as 'the first compiler which can automatically generate symmetry-aware code for sparse or structured tensor kernels,' directly extending the tensor algebra compiler framework (TACO) with symmetry support; shared author Amarasinghe confirms own-group lineage, and the abstract's framing of 'existing compilers cannot' positions this as a direct extension of TACO.
title: SySTeC: A Symmetric Sparse Tensor Compiler
